Fluid or wallpaper backdrop, light-glass panels, custom knobs,"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" and the drifting-glow cursor treatment."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-theme-mineradio"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Mineradio** is a cinematic glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — a faithful re-ski"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"n of the Mineradio "private visual radio" identity. The header, sidebar, composer, stats line, and t"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rajectory view become panes of warm champagne glass over a near-black studio backdrop. You can put a"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" video as wallpaper and switch it off and the stock UI comes back exactly, with no source changes to"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"llpaper and switch it off and the stock UI comes back exactly, with no source changes to DSH itself."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Dark studio: teal glass over a champagne pour. The prompt floats in the liquid."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Live captures of 2.2.x on DeepSeek Harness — hero, paper-white, and the Looks panel (scenes / perfor"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"of 2.2.x on DeepSeek Harness — hero, paper-white, and the Looks panel (scenes / performance / mica):"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Dark studio | Light paper |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Looks: Studio / Deep sea / Midnight / Mist / Rainbow, plus Performance / Balanced / Vivid — one clic"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"k, same glass family."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"A full-size gallery is also hosted at **https://dhicoc.github.io/dsh-theme-mineradio/**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What ports from Mineradio"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Champagne-gold identity** — the signature palette (`#f4d28a` champagne, `#7ad7c2` mint, `#ff5367"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"` ember rose over a warm near-black `#08090B`) drives every alias token: surfaces, hairline strokes,"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" text ink, buttons, scrollbars, and warm-tinted shadows with a gold bloom.
- **Typography** — Inter "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"+ Noto Sans SC for the UI, self-hosted so there's no shell/fontsource dependency.
- **Cinematic glow"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"** — a champagne-gold ambient bloom sits behind the glass; the spotlight hue knob sweeps it from war"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"m amber to mint while keeping the brand warm.
- **Fluid backdrop** — a living fluid board (hue + dep"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"th adjustable, defaults to warm gold) or your own wallpaper (image or video) with its own blur and f"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"justable, defaults to warm gold) or your own wallpaper (image or video) with its own blur and frost."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Two modes**: **Mica** restyles the layout into floating glass cards (blur and frost adjustable),"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" while **Compatibility Mode** keeps the stock layout byte-for-byte and only swaps the material to ge"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"neric glass — other plugins' UI gets the same treatment automatically
- **Free backdrop**: a living "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"fluid board (hue adjustable) or your own wallpaper (fills the page, aspect preserved, with its own b"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"lur and frost); light wallpapers look best in light mode, dark wallpapers in dark mode
- **Backgroun"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"d brightness**: follows the resolved scheme — dark mode darkens (0–50), light mode brightens (50–100"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"), 50 is unchanged
- **Ambient decor**: particle whale in the chat center, star particles, and an in"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"teractive dot-grid mesh — all toggleable
- **Champagne glow**: a pointer-tracking glow over the glas"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"s panes, plus a hover press-down for tactile depth
- One switch: off restores the stock UI exactly, "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"and every effect is removed with the plugin"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### How coverage works (3.0)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Earlier versions decided what to style from class-name word roots, at a fixed specificity. Against t"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"he real 0.2.0-rc.2 shell that loses: the shell paints an opaque `--dsw-alias-bg-base` on its tab hos"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"t, centre column and conversation column, and any host rule above that specificity wins outright — w"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"hich is why patches kept missing areas. 3.0 covers surfaces three ways instead, in this order:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. **Design tokens**, through the official `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` seam. It writes inline custo"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"m properties on `body`, so it wins without `!important` and without a specificity contest. Measured "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"against the rc.2 sources, 97% of painted backgrounds resolve to a token, so this one layer reaches n"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"early every surface — including into `::before`/`::after`, which inherit them.
2. **A runtime role c"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ensus** for what tokens cannot express. It reads *computed paint and geometry* — never class names —"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" and stamps `data-md-role` (`ground`, `structure`, `pane`, `overlay`, `control`, `chip`). The styles"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"heet then dresses by role with `!important`, so priority decides rather than a specificity race. It "},{"id":"p17s8","text":"re-runs for elements added after mount, which is most of a React UI, and finishes in ~25 ms over 600"},{"id":"p17s9","text":" elements.
3. **Carve-outs that stay stock.** Code, terminals, form fields and file previews keep th"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"eir own fill and get no blur; containers that *hold* code (program source, diff bodies, consoles) ar"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"e carved out too, so the text behind them is not greyed. The host's positional anchors are never tou"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"ched, because a `backdrop-filter` on them would re-anchor every in-place overlay. Faces that already"},{"id":"p17s13","text":" wear the family rim are left alone, so hand-tuned panes keep their look."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"A popover whose plate is drawn by a covering `::before` is detected and dressed on the *pseudo-eleme"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nt*, so the box stays clean instead of stacking a second layer of glass."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"You can inspect it live: `__mineradioCensus()` reports how many faces carry each role, `__mineradioC"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ensus(true)` re-runs the pass, and `__mineradioAudit()` sweeps for opaque surfaces the theme did not"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"rue)` re-runs the pass, and `__mineradioAudit()` sweeps for opaque surfaces the theme did not reach."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Windows (one command)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Installs the **latest release** by default. No git needed — the installer falls back to a plain zip "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"download. It links the plugin into the profile's `node_modules` and registers `ui-mineradio` in `cor"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"dis.patch.yml` (idempotent — safe to run again). Reload the web UI and it is on."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Pin a version or track the dev branch:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Plugin market / npm (recommended)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Or search **dsh-theme-mineradio** in Settings → Plugin market. That installs the prebuilt npm packag"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e (`lib/` already bundled). There is **no** `prepare` / `postinstall` script."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"From 2.3.6 the theme probes the host at load: it uses `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` when present"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" (DSH `0.1.1-rc.2+`) and falls back to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` (DSH Desktop 0.7.x / `0.1.2-a"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"lpha.1`). Do not pin 2.3.1 for old desktops and 2.3.5 for new ones — one latest build runs on both."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
